name: Batch Classification & Sorting
purpose: Batch categorize / label / extract over a list of text items using a weak local model, via model.gateway (Module 7). For each item it builds a mode-specific prompt, calls the gateway (default tier weak = Qwen2.5-1.5B), parses the completion into a structured per-item result, computes a classification-appropriate confidence (a documented completeness+validity heuristic, NOT calibrated correctness), groups the results, and routes below-threshold items to review_queue.jsonl. First real consumer of model.gateway.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Mode <classify|multilabel|extract>; -Tier <tiny|weak|mid|strong> | -Model <model_id>; -Labels <array> (classify/multilabel) | -Fields <array> (extract); -Items <array> | -ItemsPath <file>; sampling/limits -MaxTokens -Temperature -Seed -MaxInputChars -ConfidenceThreshold; plumbing -Registry -GatewayPath -PwshPath -ReviewQueuePath. OR -InputsJson '<json {mode,tier,model,labels,fields,items,items_path,max_tokens,temperature,seed,max_input_chars,confidence_threshold,registry,gateway_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: classify (one label) | multilabel (zero+ labels) | extract (named fields).

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Batch of items: [{id?,text}] or [string]. Via InputsJson. Provide this or items_path.

inputs.name: items_path
inputs.description: Path to a .jsonl (one {id?,text}/string per line) or .json array of items.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Closed label set for classify/multilabel: [string] or [{name,description?}]. Descriptions steer the model.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Named fields to pull for extract: [string] or [{name,description?}].

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: Gateway LLM tier: tiny|weak|mid|strong. Default weak = Qwen2.5-1.5B.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Per-item generation cap. Mode defaults: classify 24, multilabel 48, extract 220.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed passed to the gateway for reproducibility.

inputs.name: max_input_chars
inputs.description: Truncate each item's text to this many chars before prompting.

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Per-item confidence below this is flagged to the review queue.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Path to the gateway's models.json (passed through to model.gateway).

inputs.name: gateway_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-ModelGateway.ps1 (default: resolved from modules/07-model-gateway).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh executable used to spawn the gateway child (default the dotnet-tool pwsh).

inputs.name: review_queue_path
inputs.description: Where THIS skill writes flagged items (default: repo-root review_queue.jsonl).

outputs.description: { mode, model, selected_from, labels?|fields?, count, ok_count, flagged_count, error_count, confidence_threshold, max_tokens, temperature, seed, items[ {id,input_preview,status,label?|labels?|extracted?,confidence,finish_reason,parsed,in_set,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,raw_preview,flagged,flag_reason,review_id,error} ], groups{label->[ids]}, review_queue_path, review_count }

models: a GGUF LLM via model.gateway (default the weak tier)
